title: Put Magic in Hand
description: The Tower can now support formal spell study. Use Iron's own spellcraft progression rather than treating its schools as separate cosmologies: equip a spell book and establish scroll-forging capability so active mana can be studied, recorded, and wielded deliberately.
description_completed: The Overlord has entered Iron's active spellcraft on its own terms, with a spell book equipped and scroll-forging capability established.
